content: मेचक {%a.%} [<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 5. 37</ls>] Black, dark-blue, dark-coloured; कुर्वन्नञ्जनमेचका इव दिशो मेघः समुत्तिष्ठते <ls>Mk. 5. 23</ls>; <ls>U. 6. 25</ls>; <ls>Me. 61</ls>; <ls>Rām. 5. 22. 26</ls>. .{@-कः@} .²1 Blackness, the dark-blue colour. .²2 An eye of a peacockʼs tail; प्रेङ्खद्भूरिमयूखमेचकचयैः <ls>Māl. 6. 5</ls>. .²3 A cloud. .²4 Smoke. .²5 A nipple. .²6 A kind of gem. .{@-कम्@} .²1 Darkness. .²2 Sulphuret of antimony.
